jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: The panel's own work queue. Deployments, backups, spec publication and the nightly sweeps all run through it, so a stalled queue looks like a dozen unrelated things being broken.
jobs.health.title: Queue

jobs.health.failing.one: {count} job has a current failure streak.
jobs.health.failing.other: {count} jobs have a current failure streak.

jobs.health.stoppedWarning: Work is due and no worker has picked any of it up. That is not a slow queue, it is a stopped one: check that this panel is running with its scheduler enabled, and that nothing else is holding the lock.
jobs.list.empty.title: Nothing is failing
jobs.list.empty.description: Every scheduled job either succeeded or has not run into trouble yet.
jobs.action.retry.title: Run {task} now?
jobs.action.retry.body: Its next attempt is scheduled further out after every failure; this clears that wait and the streak of {failures}, and hands it to a worker immediately. If the cause has not been fixed it will simply fail again, which is harmless.
jobs.action.discard.title: Discard {task}?
jobs.action.discard.body: The row is deleted and the work is not done. Nothing retries it and nothing else notices: whatever was waiting on it - a deployment, a backup, a spec the node has not been sent - stays unfinished until somebody does it another way.
jobs.action.discard.requireTextLabel: Type the task name to confirm
